zeroUiOwnedFinancialTruth.description: UI is strictly prohibited from mutating financial balances; all surfaces consume journal-projected state.

deterministicOperationPipeline.pipeline: UI Action -> PREPARED Operation -> Journal Commit -> Projection Rebuild -> Money Flow -> COMMITTED -> UI Refresh

rateRevisionHistoricalImmutability.description: Historical paid installments remain locked to their historical applied rates; only future projections re-amortize.

destructiveRecoveryAndSelfHealing.description: Derived projections can be destroyed or corrupted; pure replay from the immutable journal restores 100% canonical hash match.

p2pModuleFreeze.description: Core 143 P2P accounting invariant tests remain byte-for-byte untouched and certified green.
